## 1. Technical Environment
* Plugin Version: dso v1.17.7
* code_version: cf69e7bd09b86ee19f3fefae0a9ee5f83ea0b8bd
* Discovered during: bug 9788 fix test gate; pre-existing and unrelated to 9788.

## 2. Incident Overview
### Expected Behavior
The file tests/skills/dso_ci_review/verify_pr80_schema_compliance.py is mapped in .test-index line 215 as a runner.py test. When invoked by the test gate it should either pass (if test functions exist) or be exempted (if it's a verification script).

### Actual Behavior
The file is documented in its own docstring as a 'controlled verification run (not a unit test)' — it has 0 `def test_*` functions. pytest collects 0 tests and exits 5. record-test-status.sh interprets this as a failure, blocking commits.

Fix options: (a) remove the file from .test-index line 215, (b) add a test_* wrapper that calls the verification logic, (c) rename to _verify_ prefix so pytest doesn't try to collect.

## 3. Reproduction
`python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/verify_pr80_schema_compliance.py` → exit 5, 'no tests ran in 0.02s'.
data.title: [verify_pr80_schema_compliance]: file in .test-index has 0 test_* functions -> pytest exit 5 treated as failure
